verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework that lets developers build agents, for example agents that use tools to query databases. That is a developer building block for constructing an insights feature, not an in-product feature that gives the user AI-generated insights on their own data. Studio is documented only for testing agents, running workflows and inspecting traces, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
